admission.justification: Viewer history, scroll restoration and body reclamation jointly prevent lost reading positions or lost navigation entries after memory reclamation.

applicability: In-session File Viewer navigation through files opened under its current repository and scope.
conditions: The outgoing history entry saves its scroll position before navigation, including a saved zero.
A saved position takes precedence over the link's first-arrival anchor.
Body reclamation retains every navigation entry and reloads a released body when revisited.
exclusions: Keeping navigation after selecting another repository or scope.

evidence: producer-proof-locators.json: BUG-R05@v1 §10; dashboard/src/panels/file-viewer/FileViewer.test.tsx :: opens a document rendered, and Back and Forward lead through opened files; dashboard/src/panels/file-viewer/viewerHistory.test.ts :: keeps the scroll position of the entry being left; dashboard/src/panels/file-viewer/viewerHistory.test.ts :: reclaims the oldest bodies but never a count of navigable entries

statement: The file viewer keeps back and forward file history with each saved scroll position and disables a direction at its history boundary.
